parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865 (HDAC6) where compounds have a canonical SMILES and the source document is PubMed-indexed. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join required), then to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Return all requested columns without deduplication, preserving row multiplicity. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
